lastSummary: NC-043 fixed: Completed tasks accumulate indefinitely during normal use. removeCompleted() existed but was never called by extension code. (1) TaskQueue now has configurable maxHistorySize (default 100) and maxHistoryAgeMs (default 30 min) via TaskQueueOptions interface. (2) Auto-prune runs after every terminal state transition (complete/fail/cancel) — age-based removal via removeCompleted() plus size-based LRU removal of oldest terminal tasks. (3) TaskQueueManager passes options through and exposes getCompletedTasks(), getCompletedCount(), pruneCompletedTasks(), and getTotalTaskCount(). (4) Constructor backward-compatible: number argument still works. 29 new regression tests. 1426/1426 tests pass. Build clean. All type-checks clean.
